You don't need to wait. Per our policy, if tracking shows delivered but nothing arrived, contact support and we'll open a courier investigation, which takes up to 5 business days. If the package is confirmed lost, you can choose a free replacement or a full refund.

Since today is Sunday, chat is closed and reopens Monday at 8am your local time. You can email help@leafy.example now and expect a reply within 1 business day. Please include your order number (LF- plus six digits).
